title: API Design for Production: Contracts, Pagination & Safe Changes
concept: Design HTTP APIs that clients can rely on for years: resources and status codes, one error contract, contract-first OpenAPI, cursor pagination, safe filtering and sorting, idempotency keys and backward-compatible changes, each taught from a real API incident and graded with small TypeScript programs.
description: An intermediate course for backend developers whose API already has clients they cannot update overnight. Every lesson starts from an incident on the CodeDev learning platform's public API - a mobile app that shows the same course twice while scrolling, an error body that is different on every endpoint, a retried request that enrolls a learner twice, a sort parameter that reaches the SQL string, a renamed field that breaks every app still on last month's version - and fixes it with production API design: resource modeling, mapping outcomes to status codes, a single error contract with a trace id, OpenAPI as the contract and contract tests, cursor pagination with a stable order, whitelisted filters and sorts, idempotency keys, detecting breaking changes between schema versions, and shipping a breaking change with a compatibility window and deprecation. 10 lessons with quizzes on real requests and responses and hands-on TypeScript challenges.
